title: sorbus rivularis
intro: Sorbus rivularis, commonly known as the Chinese Rowan or Mountain Ash, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its edible fruit, which has been used in traditional medicine to promote digestive health and reduce inflammation. The health benefits of Sorbus rivularis include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
